name: TMS OS V15.3.8
notes: V15.3.8: Sua loi gan ten mien Cloudflare Hosting khong them route vao tunnel (giao dien bao 'hoat dong' nhung truy cap 404). Giam tinh route that tren Cloudflare va hien trang thai route (Route OK / Chua co route) trong panel.
features: attachHostname: sau khi PUT cau hinh tunnel tren Cloudflare, he thong doc lai de XAC NHAN route da ton that. Neu chua co, thu lai 1 lan sau 1.5s; van khong co se rollback DNS vua tao va bao loi ro rang
Trang thai route that: status() doc ingress thuc te tren Cloudflare, moi ten mien trong 'Ten mien dang hoat dong' hien badge 'Route OK' (xanh) hoac 'Chua co route' (cam) kem giai thich
Dashboard bao ro: route chua co tren tunnel nghia la truy cap se 404, khong de nguoi dung nghi ten mien da hoat dong
changelog: V15.3.8: fix gan ten mien Cloudflare khong them route vao tunnel; hien trang thai route that (Route OK / Chua co route).
